exposure: vaginal repair of cesarean section scar defect (CSD) combined with a gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonist (GnRHa)
outcome: Thickness of the remaining muscular layer (TRM)
Length, width and depth of the CSD
cohort: 124 women with cesarean section scar defect (CSD)
finding: Vaginal repair combined with GnRHa was more effective than vaginal repair alone in improving scar healing, reducing menstruation duration, and increasing TRM in women with CSD.
mod_finding: Combining vaginal repair with GnRHa led to better outcomes for cesarean section scar defect compared to vaginal repair alone.
